title: Odd Even Linked List
description: Group all odd-indexed nodes together followed by even-indexed nodes in a singly linked list.

data.text: Given `head`, reorder the list so that all odd-indexed nodes come before all even-indexed nodes, preserving the relative order within each group.

data.title: Separate Lists O(n) O(n)
Relink O(n) O(1)
What improved
data.text: The two-list method clones nodes into fresh lists, which is wasteful. The in-place approach threads two pointers through the same nodes, alternating between odd and even positions. At the end, the odd tail simply connects to the stored even head. No new nodes are allocated.

cards.title: Two New Lists
cards.description: Collect odds and evens into separate lists

cards.title: In-Place Relink
cards.description: Thread odd and even pointers through the original list
